constraints: Keep the base image, Compose image, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use couchdb on one supported CouchDB release line.
Confirm the application and its data or configuration work on the target CouchDB release; read the vendor's upgrade notes before moving across several release lines.

steps.instructions: Change the reported FROM line or Compose image to a tag on a supported release line, and pin it to a digest if your policy requires.
steps.title: Update the base image

steps.instructions: Update other Dockerfiles, Compose files, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use the same image so they agree.
steps.title: Align other image references

verification.purpose: Build the image on the new base.
Confirm the container starts on the new base.

rules.replacement: A couchdb image on a supported release line
rules.summary: The CouchDB project publishes CVE fixes only for the current release series and its immediate predecessor, so these older release lines receive no security fixes by policy.
rules.title: Apache CouchDB image release lines 3.3 and older are end-of-life
